Two independent sources confirm this is a natural-gas pipeline. (1) The CNPC facilities table (pdftotext-verified) lists 中缅钦州支线 under section header '三、天然气管道' (III. Natural Gas Pipelines), directly under CNPC's Southwest Pipeline Branch table -- unambiguous classification as gas, separate from the document's section I (crude oil) and II (refined products). (2) The 2021 procurement notice (read as image) states the branch runs '起自西二线南宁支干线的南宁末站' (originating from the West-East Gas Pipeline No.2 Nanning trunk-branch's Nanning terminal), i.e. it is a branch off a natural-gas trunk system, with volumetric throughput given in 万m³/d (cubic meters, the standard gas unit, not tons). Both confirm Fuel=Gas.

Single strong primary source: the CNPC/Southwest Pipeline Branch facilities table row for 中缅钦州支线 gives 投产时间 (commissioning date) 2014/7/6, matching recorded StartYear1=2014 exactly (verified via `pdftotext -layout`, which the automated verifier's substring screen missed -- documented PDF-extraction false negative).
